description: This file provides Greek translations for the Select2 library version 4.0.6-rc.1, defining localized strings for UI messages and errors.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to delete characters when input exceeds maximum allowed length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters when input length is less than the minimum required.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message indicating that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching.
